answer: The mesa decay curve is applied at each close, atlas records the drop, and cedar recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks as a result finds them worthless when it returns to them. Standing decays sharply after 4 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. Every extra alias adds 14 hours of verification and 11 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
